createOrReplace.title: Waterloo — Honours Arts (includes Economics) requirements for American (US) system students
createOrReplace.excerpt: Grade 12 English, minimum final grade of 75%. Minimum Grade 12 average of low 80s. High school diploma with prerequisite courses completed at the AP level and/or Grade 12 senior academic level; school must hold current accreditation from a recognized American regional education body. Economics programme page: 'Not studying in Ontario? Search our admission requirements for Honours Arts or Honours Arts and Business'; high school Calculus strongly recommended (not required).
createOrReplace.retrieval_method: Playwright (headed Chrome) on official page, EvidaPath 2026-10-31

createOrReplace.academic_threshold: Minimum Grade 12 average in the low 80s (Waterloo's wording; read here as 80%), via Honours Arts. Grade 12 English at 75% or higher. Calculus strongly recommended, not required. SAT/ACT not required. Admission is competitive.

language_requirements.min_score: IELTS 6.5 overall; minimum 6.5 in writing and speaking; minimum 6.0 in reading and listening.
language_requirements.notes: Required if four most recent years of full-time education were not in English. Also accepts TOEFL iBT 90 (25 writing and speaking), PTE Academic 63, Duolingo 120.

set.notes: Official 2027 fee schedule (Bachelor of Computer Science (Honours), September 2027): tuition RM127,776 over 3 years, shown per year. Compulsory fees, including the 6% Service Tax charged to non-Malaysian students, shown separately. Excludes the refundable RM3,000 security deposit.

extension_metadata.fields.value: Tuition RM127,776 ÷ 3 = RM42,592/yr (2027 schedule; total programme fees RM147,640 without SST incl. the RM3,000 refundable deposit). Replaces the earlier figure, which divided the grand total (incl. deposit and other fees) by the years.

Compulsory non-tuition fees RM16,864 over 3 years plus 6% Service Tax RM8,464.56 = RM25,328.56, i.e. RM8,442.85/yr. Service Tax per the schedule's Note 1: 6% for non-Malaysian citizens on all fees and charges except Hospitalisation & Surgical Insurance, International Security Deposit and EMGS application fees; taxable = tuition RM127,776 + 2,800 enrolment + 3,000 international student charge + 7,500 international student annual fee = RM141,076. Refundable security deposit (RM3,000) not counted. (The schedule's own 'Total Fees With SST' column, RM156,498, applies 6% to the whole total incl. exempt items, about RM131/yr more.)
